title.narrative: HPN - HealthIT: Sustaining Use of District Health Information System II

description.narrative: (Kenya): Using FY 2022 funds, USAID will support the HealthIT activity, the goal of which is to provide technical support to the Ministry of Health (MoH) on the evolution and strengthening of sustainable health information systems (HIS) that are responsive to user needs, providing vital data for planning, decision making, and accountability within the health sector. ..More specifically, HealthIT will support the MoH in hosting HIS solutions in the new MoH data center in particular by working with the MoH to roll-out the Digital Health Platform (DHP), an integrated system that will support data management for all health program areas. The integrated DHP will provide critical data for tracking individual patient outcomes, program performance and prioritization of interventions. The activity will support the MoH and counties to generate quality Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health (RMNCAH), nutrition, HIV/TB and malaria data for use in evidence-based decision making by all stakeholders; and provide real-time health commodities data through the Kenya Health Information System (KHIS) Health Commodities dashboard. Additionally, HealthIT will support the development of a digital platform for capturing household data that will inform net distribution to communities during the 2024 mass net campaign..Additionally, the activity will provide technical support in the maintenance of the Epidemic Preparedness and Response (EPR) dashboard that pulls data from the KHIS system to inform epidemic threshold setting and development of annual county EPR plans. Finally, the activity will use FY 2022 funds to provide technical support and oversight of TIBU-the national tuberculosis surveillance database. The activity will help integrate TIBU with other electronic medical record and surveillance systems including KHIS, DHP and Kenya Electronic Medical Records System both at national and service delivery points. This activity is also receiving HIV funds.
